Scope: Synthetic HttpMessageHandler only: no live HTTP, disk persistence, OAuth or IMAP/SMTP claim.
Checks: one store/session retains cookies across requests; independent sessions isolate same-origin cookies; HttpOnly stays privileged
explicit store reuse preserves memory state; a fresh store does not restore cookies from disk
CookiesEnabled=false and CredentialsMode.Omit suppress both sending and storing cookies
host HopPolicy rejects an unapproved redirect before handler dispatch
host cancellation is honored; disposed sessions reject sends; externally owned stores require explicit clearing
